data_description.host: If the Brain's address changes, it's found again and updated automatically.
data_description.port: The AVA OS port. Default is 3000.
data_description.include_hidden: Off by default. Hidden flows are ones AVA keeps out of its own menus, usually internal building blocks.
data_description.include_disabled: Disabled flows are switched off in AVA but still work when pressed.
data_description.clean_poweroff_names: Renames AVA's auto-named power-off flows, like "XBOX (2) (2)", after the flow they turn off: "XBOX – Power Off". Names you set in AVA are kept.
data_description.show_sidebar_panel: Adds an AVA Flows page to the sidebar where you can run, rename and copy flows, and export the list.
